name: Drop RELOAD_DUMP_DIR, use DPATH
description: User decision: remove the RELOAD_DUMP_DIR feature; RELOAD DUMP <name> always writes to cwd (DPATH/lib dir). Keep plain-name validation, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, 0600, PRIV_RESTART+PRIV_DIE. Scope: ircd/ircd_features.c (remove F_S), include/ircd_features.h (remove FEAT_ enum), ircd/hotreload.c (hotreload_dump_to_path: drop feature_str, path=<name> in cwd), doc/readme.reload+readme.features+example.conf (remove RELOAD_DUMP_DIR, note dumps go to DPATH), tests/docker/ircd-tls-hub.conf (remove line), tests/hotreload/test_reload_dump.py+helpers (read from /opt/ircu/lib). SEQUENCED after hotreload-scale-tests + hotreload-abi-guard merge to avoid test-file/working-tree collisions.
